conclusions: The scan includes submillimeter and larger lengths; testability varies with length and width and is not bridge evidence.
Reverse prediction depends on mask and source; a training-selected GO combination does not consistently beat the B axis.
Every GO and fixed control is retained, including untestable conditions.

panels.scale_support: all length by halfwidth evaluable/attempted combinations
panels.reverse_leave_section: individual held-out sections, all3 masks and2 cohorts,3 fixed model families
panels.reverse_leave_cohort: same comparison with source holdout; unknown patient independence
panels.all_GO_inverse: 1691 rows in frozen panel order; all masks/splits/cohorts; radial/angular/full arms
panels.all_controls_inverse: all51 fixed controls in original order

exports: PDF TrueType text; heatmap embedded image
statistics: AUC per eligible section; diamond=section mean; no patient CI or significance stars; gray=not testable. No image smoothing.
